title: Grand Aqueduct Reservoir
author: Inbar Rose
architectNote: The grand culmination of the Sunken Aqueducts. Coordinate keys across flooded canals and elevated piers to breach the Grand Spillway.

help.title: Level 36: Grand Aqueduct Reservoir
help.message: Two ancient gates lock the Spillway. Traverse both the submerged canals and high bridges to gather the required keys.
